blocks.text: Willingdon Heights Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Willingdon Heights strata homes sit between Boundary Road on the west and Willingdon Avenue on the east, with Hastings Street on the north and Lougheed Highway on the south.

Hastings Street, at the north edge, carries the area's apartment buildings, including the new project site at 4488 Hastings Street at Willingdon Avenue. That corner is the Willingdon Heights–Capitol Hill edge, one block east of Willingdon Avenue.

Brentwood Town Centre, a City-designated town centre, is immediately southeast across Lougheed Highway. The City lists Brentwood among Burnaby's four town centres, and its towers begin south of the Willingdon Heights house and low-rise streets.

blocks.text: Willingdon Heights Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The attached stock is apartment condos along Hastings Street and Willingdon Avenue and townhome complexes on the side streets between them, in freehold strata form. Under the Strata Property Act, each home is a strata lot and the corporation owns the common property, including the land under a townhome complex.
Centràle, at 4488 Hastings Street, is the newest named project at the area's northeast corner, a 34-home condo project by First Track Development at Willingdon Avenue and Hastings Street.
Older low-rise strata buildings, not towers, are the established stock inside Willingdon Heights itself.
Rental and pet rules are building-specific here.

blocks.text: Willingdon Heights Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A secondary suite inside a Willingdon Heights strata townhome cannot be sold on its own title.

A house lot behind the Hastings Street buildings can now hold a stratified multiplex. Lots in the R1 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) District with two or more primary dwelling units may be stratified, which is the route by which new ground-oriented strata homes appear on Willingdon Heights side streets.
Strata bylaw and fee disputes here go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal (CRT). The Province's strata framework routes many of those disputes to the CRT rather than to court.

blocks.text: Willingdon Heights Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Parkcrest Elementary, at 6055 Halifax Street, is the elementary school on the Halifax Street corridor east of Willingdon Avenue. The City's 2026 election notice lists Parkcrest Elementary School at 6055 Halifax Street as a voting location, confirming the civic address.

Burnaby North Secondary, at 751 Hammarskjold Drive, is the secondary school named in the same City notice for this side of Burnaby. Its Hammarskjold Drive campus sits northeast of the Willingdon Heights strata streets.

SD41 cross-district transfers are a February application, not a move-in right. A family in a Willingdon Heights condo who wants a school outside the home attendance area must apply to the requested school during February for the coming school year.
A rented suite inside a Willingdon Heights townhome is billed as its own utility line.

blocks.text: Willingdon Heights Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Brentwood Town Centre Station and Gilmore Station, on the Millennium Line, are the rapid-transit stations for the area, south of Lougheed Highway. Brentwood is one of the City's four designated town centres.

Hastings Street runs west to Boundary Road and downtown Vancouver and east toward Capitol Hill and the Barnet Highway. Willingdon Avenue runs south through Brentwood to Kingsway and Metrotown, linking a Willingdon Heights condo to both town centres.

Lougheed Highway and the Trans-Canada Highway (Highway 1) at Willingdon Avenue are the driving links south and east of the area. The Willingdon Avenue interchange sits at the southeast corner of the neighbourhood, below the Hastings Street buildings.

blocks.text: Willingdon Heights Burnaby Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check Hastings Street traffic and title charges before buying a low-rise unit on the corridor.
Check the streamside rule on any side-street townhome lot near a culverted creek.

Read the strata's registered bylaws and Form B for rental, pet and renovation rules. The Province's strata framework puts those rules in the corporation's own bylaws, with the Civil Resolution Tribunal resolving many disputes about them.

blocks.text: Willingdon Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

8 townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights with a median price of $1,090,000 (the middle half sold between $966,750 and $1,381,250), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 12% sold above list. They had a median $796 per square foot, a median year built of 2005 and a median strata fee of $623 a month. 4 condos sold in Willingdon Heights, too few (5 needed) to give a typical price.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 17 condos and townhomes listed in Willingdon Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Willingdon Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Willingdon Heights had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 condos and townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights over those 5 months, out of 916 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: Which SkyTrain stations serve a Willingdon Heights condo?
faq.a: Brentwood Town Centre Station and Gilmore Station, both on the Millennium Line, are the closest stations, south and southeast of the area across Lougheed Highway. Hastings Street and Willingdon Avenue buses connect the area's buildings to those stations, and Brentwood is the City-designated town centre for this side of Burnaby.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Hastings Street condo family?
faq.a: Parkcrest Elementary is at 6055 Halifax Street and Burnaby North Secondary is at 751 Hammarskjold Drive, and the district groups the North Burnaby elementary schools, including Westridge and Parkcrest, with Burnaby North Secondary in its Brentwood North zone material.

faq.q: What City utility charges does a strata home pay here?
faq.a: The sewer parcel tax is billed with property taxes in May and shared between the properties on the parcel, moving to the utility notice in 2027.

faq.q: Is the new building at Willingdon and Hastings part of Brentwood?
faq.a: No, 4488 Hastings Street is north of Lougheed Highway, in Willingdon Heights at the Capitol Hill edge, not in the Brentwood Town Centre plan area south of the highway.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Willingdon Heights sell for?
faq.a: 8 townhomes sold in Willingdon Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,090,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Willingdon Heights?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (12% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
